title: Sixth Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World | IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: The Lemurian condition precedes Steiner’s Atlantean differentiation of human consciousness.
interpretation_qualification: Use as a sequence within the esoteric narrative.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: Steiner portrays early Atlanteans as relying on vivid memory and speech before increasingly independent logical thought.
interpretation_qualification: These are textual claims about his narrative, not archaeological observations.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | From Buddha to Christ — GA 109. The Principle of Spiritual Economy (1986)
paraphrase: Oracle schools cultivate distinct forms of initiation in Steiner’s Atlantean narrative.
interpretation_qualification: The number and status of the Sun and Vulcan centers are discussed separately.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: The first phase is characterized by retention of vivid sensory impressions and development of speech with formative power.
interpretation_qualification: The stage numbering is editorial. Steiner uses obsolete Theosophical racial terminology.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: The second phase adds a sense of personal value and memory of actions that win recognition.
interpretation_qualification: The text links these changes with the beginnings of communal remembrance.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: Steiner makes remembered personal experience, tradition and continuity of leadership more important in the third phase.
interpretation_qualification: This is his account of early political organization.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: The fourth phase uses inherited capacities for selfish ends, to which Steiner connects destructive effects.
interpretation_qualification: GA 13 IV also discusses misuse of growth and reproductive forces at the level of Atlantis as a whole.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: The fifth phase develops an inner basis for decisions through thought and checks the dominance of personal desire.
interpretation_qualification: Steiner depicts the transition as a shift of motive into the individual.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: The sixth phase uses thinking more extensively for social rules and wider collective organization.
interpretation_qualification: This is the conceptual change described in GA 11.

title: Chapter 3. Our Atlantean Ancestors — Cosmic Memory (1959)
paraphrase: Steiner combines developing thought with a stronger retention of earlier traits in the seventh phase.
interpretation_qualification: No application of his racial labels to living peoples is warranted.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | From Buddha to Christ — GA 109. The Principle of Spiritual Economy (1986)
paraphrase: The preservers of initiation and the seven teachers connect Atlantis to Steiner’s Ancient Indian epoch.
interpretation_qualification: In GA 13 the teacher appoints seven disciples. GA 109 supplies the name Manu.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | From Buddha to Christ — GA 109. The Principle of Spiritual Economy (1986)
paraphrase: The First Post-Atlantean account describes surviving older supersensible perception. Atlantean continuity is an interpretive link across the passages.
interpretation_qualification: The term picture-consciousness is broader in other Steiner contexts.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner describes a turn toward shaping the sensory world under the instruction of ancient Persian culture.
interpretation_qualification: The same chapter distinguishes the esoteric Zarathustra from simple historical identification.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner describes a search for spiritual laws within sensory appearance, including star observation in the third period.
interpretation_qualification: The zodiac node identifies the broader astral study route.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | VI. The Present and Future of Cosmic Evolution — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner relates greater investment in sensory earthly life to consolidation of intellect and feeling.
interpretation_qualification: The use of the intellectual soul as a graph connection is editorial.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | VI. The Present and Future of Cosmic Evolution — Occult Science (1972) | Lecture III — GA 231. Supersensible Man (1961)
paraphrase: The fifth epoch develops independent engagement with sensory knowledge and the conditions for renewed awareness of spirit.
interpretation_qualification: GA 102 III locates the first stirrings of the consciousness soul much earlier, late in Atlantis.

title: IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972) | VI. The Present and Future of Cosmic Evolution — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner projects a further reconciliation of life in the spirit with material culture and voluntary conscious perception.
interpretation_qualification: The sixth epoch is a subdivision of Earth evolution.

title: VI. The Present and Future of Cosmic Evolution — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: A major transition follows the seventh cultural period and opens a new series of earthly conditions.
interpretation_qualification: GA 13 provides a transition marker. A separate detailed seventh-period profile remains open.

title: Seventh Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: Steiner describes Spirits of Personality teaching and guiding in the Lemurian narrative through beings from the Venus sphere.
interpretation_qualification: The esoteric Venus terminology is the one explained in the lecture.

title: Seventh Lecture — GA 110. Spiritual Hierarchies and their Reflection in the Physical World
paraphrase: Steiner brings Mercury spirits and Archangels into his later account of Atlantean leadership.
interpretation_qualification: The passage uses the esoteric Mercury terminology.

title: Chapter 6. The Division into Sexes — Cosmic Memory (1959) | IV. The Evolution of the Cosmos and Man — Occult Science (1972)
paraphrase: Steiner connects early bodily differentiation with changes in reproductive organization and the increasing inward use of life forces.
interpretation_qualification: The esoteric account is not historical evidence about human origins or a biological explanation of sex.
